answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every atlas settlement recomputes the lantern schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
